metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1982 · Missing
metas.description: When an idealistic American writer disappears during the Chilean coup d'état in September 1973, his wife and father try to find him.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1971 · The Devils
metas.description: In 17th-century France, Father Urbain Grandier's protection of the city of Loudun from the corrupt Cardinal Richelieu is undermined by a sexually repressed nun's accusation of witchcraft.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1980 · Coal Miner's Daughter
metas.description: The fictionalized life of singer Loretta Lynn, a girl who rose from humble beginnings to become a country music star in the 1960s/70s.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1978 · The Last Waltz
metas.description: A film account and presentation of the final concert of The Band.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1974 · The Enigma of Kaspar Hauser
metas.description: A young man named Kaspar Hauser suddenly appears in Nuremberg in 1828, barely able to talk or walk, and bearing a strange note.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1974 · Lenny
metas.description: The story of acerbic 1960s comic Lenny Bruce, whose groundbreaking, no-holds-barred style and social commentary was often deemed by the Establishment as too obscene for the public.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1980 · Lion of the Desert
metas.description: In 1929, Italian Fascist dictator Benito Mussolini appoints General Rodolfo Graziani as colonial governor to Italian Libya with orders to stamp-out all resistance from Libyan nationalists led by rebel guerrilla leader Omar Mukhtar.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1985 · Mishima: A Life in Four Chapters
metas.description: A fictionalized account in four chapters of the life of celebrated Japanese writer Yukio Mishima.

metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 1976 · The Message
metas.description: The story of prophet "Muhammad" and the delivery of the message of God "Allah."

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1971 · 10 Rillington Place
metas.description: What happened to the women at 10 Rillington Place? The story of British serial killer John Christie, who committed most or all of his crimes in the titular terraced house, and the miscarriage of justice involving Timothy Evans.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1983 · Barefoot Gen
metas.description: A powerful statement against war, Barefoot Gen is a disturbing story about the effect of the atomic bomb on a boy's life and the lives of the Japanese people.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1971 · Brian's Song
metas.description: Buzz Kulik's beloved tearjerker is based on the real-life friendship between Chicago Bears teammates Brian Piccolo and Gale Sayers and the bond that was strengthened when Piccolo discovers that he has a fatal disease.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1984 · The Times of Harvey Milk
metas.description: A documentary of the successful career and assassination of San Francisco's first elected gay city supervisor.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1971 · Michael the Brave
metas.description: At the end of the 16th century Wallachian ruler Prince Michael the Brave overcame the adversity of the Ottoman and Austrian Empires to unite Wallachia, Moldavia and Transylvania into one country.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1973 · Ludwig
metas.description: The reign of the tormented Ludwig, king of Bavaria, from 1864 to 1886.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1987 · The Story of Hachikō
metas.description: The true story about a dog's loyalty to its master, even after his death.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1988 · Imagine: John Lennon
metas.description: A biography of the rock music star.
